The payment-card detector ships a per-language context table: the keyword
that vouches for a bare card number differs by language. Each line below
places a Luhn-valid card next to its language's card keyword, so the boost
should fire regardless of the surrounding language.

English: please charge the card 4111 1111 1111 1111 today.
Spanish: cargue la tarjeta 5555 5555 5555 4444 por favor.
German: bitte die Kreditkarte 4012 8888 8888 1881 belasten.
French: veuillez débiter la carte 6011 1111 1111 1117 maintenant.

Each card is valid under Luhn and each sits beside its language's keyword
("card", "tarjeta", "Kreditkarte", "carte"), so all four should be detected
as payment cards and redacted.
